claim: c1 (PREREGISTRATION.md): steady 2-D incompressible NACA 0012, k-omega SST, Re = 6e6, alpha in {0, 2.15, 10, 15} deg
principle: The executing agent holds only an SSH key whose forced command is gate.sh; every effect on the server is an action listed here, executed with fixed arguments, logged in a hash-chained effect log, and checked against the protected-input manifest before and after.

status.description: report progress of the gated execution

verify.description: recompute the protected-input manifest and compare it with the frozen manifest

run_pipeline.description: set up the 16 cases from the TMR grids, run the four grids with the frozen solver settings and initialisation sequence, and apply the frozen analysis

export_results.description: stream dispositions, force and wall-resolution records, logs and the effect log to the caller as a tar archive

probe_protected_writes.description: attempt to append to PREREGISTRATION.md, reference_values.csv and the policy, and to create a file in the original evidence directory; every attempt must fail and the manifest must be unchanged

reset_work.description: remove the writable work area, for example after a failed launch

denied_by_default: Any request that is not exactly one of the action names above is refused before execution and logged.

approval.approved_by: the first author (first author, claim owner)
approval.statement: Approved in writing before any gated effect under this version. The approver installs the forced-command key and disables all other keys for the duration of the gated execution.

version_note: Version 2: the pipeline runs setup and analysis from a working copy of tools/, case_template/ and PREREGISTRATION.md verified file by file against the frozen manifest (version 1 failed at case setup because the read-only template permissions were copied); adds reset_work.
